svg.title: The action DAG the scheduler builds
svg.desc: Illustrative retrieve: the event DAG, CHUGG's timed motions per entity, the action DAG with same-entity, occupancy and event-level edges before and after RemoveRedundantEdges, and the Schedule array.

g.text: BuildActionGraph turns CHUGG's timed motions into an ADG: a chain per entity (Type 1), an edge from every earlier occupant of an overlapping footprint (Type 2), and an edge from
